name: Health Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public health data.

entries.title: Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS)
entries.description: The nation's premier system of health-related telephone surveys collecting state data on US residents' risk behaviors, chronic conditions, and use of preventive services.
entries.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
entries.attribution: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, BRFSS
entries.notes: Annual survey data released as SAS transport and ASCII files with documentation.

entries.title: CDC Open Data Portal (data.cdc.gov)
entries.description: CDC's open data portal — hundreds of public health datasets (surveillance, vital statistics, vaccination, environmental health) with a SODA API.
entries.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
entries.notes: Socrata-based portal with a SODA API.

entries.title: FluView — CDC Influenza Surveillance
entries.description: CDC's weekly U.S. influenza surveillance report — outpatient illness, virologic, hospitalization, and mortality indicators for seasonal flu.
entries.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
entries.notes: Data via FluView Interactive and the API.

entries.title: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES)
entries.description: National survey data on the health and nutrition of adults and children in the United States, combining interviews with physical examinations and laboratory tests.
entries.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)
entries.attribution: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics, NHANES
entries.notes:
Public data files and documentation are published at https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes/Default.aspx (verified 2026-08-02).
Continuous NHANES has been conducted since 1999 with public-use data released in two-year cycles; the predecessor National Health Examination Survey began in 1959.

entries.title: National Vital Statistics System (NVSS)
entries.description: CDC/NCHS system for U.S. vital statistics data on births, deaths, fetal deaths, and related records, including mortality and natality statistics.
entries.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

access.auth_note: Public-use files are open; restricted-use microdata requires an approved NCHS Research Data Center application.

entries.attribution: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics, NVSS
entries.notes:
The NVSS homepage links to CDC WONDER, downloadable final data, restricted-use data, and documentation for major vital statistics products.
Mortality public-use documentation is published at https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nvss/mortality_public_use_data.htm (verified 2026-08-02).
Much of the mortality and natality data here is queryable through CDC WONDER (catalog entry cdc-wonder); this entry covers the underlying system and its downloadable public-use files.

entries.title: PLACES: Local Data for Better Health
entries.description: Model-based small-area estimates of chronic disease measures, health behaviors, and prevention indicators for US counties, places, census tracts, and ZCTAs.
entries.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
entries.attribution: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, PLACES
entries.notes: Downloadable datasets are served via the CDC open data portal (data.cdc.gov).

entries.title: WISQARS — Injury Statistics
entries.description: CDC injury statistics query system for fatal and nonfatal injury, violent death, and cost-of-injury data in the United States.
entries.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
entries.attribution: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, WISQARS
entries.notes: Issue source URL https://www.cdc.gov/injury/wisqars/ serves a CDC meta-refresh page to the live WISQARS application at https://wisqars.cdc.gov/.

entries.title: CDC WONDER
entries.description: CDC's Wide-ranging ONline Data for Epidemiologic Research — an integrated query system for dozens of public health datasets (mortality, natality, cancer, notifiable diseases, and environmental exposures).
entries.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
entries.attribution: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, CDC WONDER
entries.notes: Query-based access; sub-national counts are privacy-suppressed. The API uses an XML request format.

entries.title: CMS Data (Medicare & Medicaid)
entries.description: Claims-based utilization, spending, and provider data for Medicare and Medicaid.

entries.title: WHO Global Health Observatory (GHO)
entries.description: The World Health Organization's portal for global health statistics — curated indicators on mortality, disease burden, health systems, and the determinants of health for WHO member states.
entries.attribution: World Health Organization, Global Health Observatory
entries.notes: Programmatic access via the GHO OData API (https://ghoapi.azureedge.net/api/). WHO data carries a non-commercial CC license — note this differs from the US-Gov public-domain entries.

entries.title: WHO Mortality Database
entries.description: Global mortality data reported annually by WHO Member States from civil registration and vital statistics systems, with cause-of-death detail for comparative epidemiological studies.
entries.attribution: World Health Organization, WHO Mortality Database
entries.notes:
The WHO page states that the database is compiled from mortality data reported annually by Member States and that the visualization/export portal covers cause-of-death data from 1950 to date. The raw data section was last updated on 23 February 2026 when verified on 2026-08-03.
WHO states that no commercial use permission is implied for these transmitted data, and the database page does not identify a named license, so the license field is intentionally narrower than the WHO GHO catalog entry.
